# The block the overpayment refusal tells a reader to write.
#
# It names the settling split with `txn_split_guid:` and declares the rest with
# `prepayment: 20.00`. Both splits are on the receivable, which is where the
# reconciliation looks for the residue.
#
# What this fixture produces: the −100.00 split in the invoice's lot with the
# invoice settled, and the −20.00 split parked in a prepayment lot of the
# customer's.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
invoice "INV-USD-001"
  customer_id: "C-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-01-05
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-05
    description: "Consulting"
    action: "Hours"
    account: "Income:Sales"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
    tax_included: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-01-05
    due: 2026-02-05
    ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
    memo: "Invoice INV-USD-001"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-03-10
    amount: 120
    account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
    prepayment: 20
    txn_guid: "5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f70819200"
    txn_split_guid: "7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f708192001122"
